title: Marketing Automation & CRM Specialist | Build Our Digital Lead-to-Sales Engine

facts: Test fixture adapted from approved V4. Not a saved Upwork job.
Our goal is to generate more customers from the leads we're already paying to acquire.
If we were generating 100 Meta leads per month but converting very few into customers, what would be the first three things you would investigate?
Build automated email and SMS follow-up workflows using approved messaging and consent-based practices.

close.title: Measure the journey
close.caption: Establish the baseline, then track response speed, confirmed appointments, and customers.

metrics.name: First-response time
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from enquiry receipt to the first approved response sent to that lead, reported separately by lead source and communication channel.

metrics.name: Confirmed appointments per 100 leads
metrics.definition: Distinct leads with an explicitly confirmed appointment divided by all leads in the same acquisition cohort, multiplied by 100. Count each lead once and use an agreed observation period.

metrics.name: Lead-to-customer conversion
metrics.definition: Distinct leads recorded as customers divided by all leads in the same acquisition cohort, multiplied by 100, using the agreed customer definition and observation period.

close.baselineNote: We’ll establish the baseline and agree the targets.
close.ctaCopy: Reply here and I'll send times.
close.beat: I'd measure response time, confirmed appointments, and customers against your agreed starting baseline. Worth a quick 15-minute call? Reply here and I'll send times.
